description: Check a finished document before sending it: does it open, page count, empty pages, characters no font can draw (HWP), {{placeholders}} or empty fields left, pages without a text layer (PDF), phrases that must not appear (forbid). Returns issues with severity.

forbid.description: Phrases that must not be anywhere in the text, e.g. names that were redacted

name: doc_check
title: Check document
